The slides and the video should tell the same story as the notebook: the problem, the evidence, the decision, and the limit.</p>

## Package (every HW)

1. **R notebook** — analysis must run  
2. **At most six slides** — the problem, the evidence, the decision, and the limit  
3. **≤ 5:00 video** — same story; simple recording is fine  

Submit on **Canvas** only (not this site).

## AI

AI is allowed on homework if you disclose it (Yellow level, when the assignment allows it). You must run the code and be able to explain the important parts of how you reached the decision. If you hide AI use, or you cannot explain the work in the video, or I suspect you used AI inappropriately, I will ask you to present in person. Depending on how you handle the questions in person, the grade on that homework can go as low as 0, and you may be reported for an academic integrity violation. See [Syllabus](../syllabus.qmd).
